_comment: Copy useful entries from this file into sources.json. This file is documentation-only and is not read by the pipeline.

fieldGuide.name: Display name shown in terminal output and reports.
fieldGuide.enabled: Whether this source is active. Set false to keep the config but skip collection.
fieldGuide.type: Supported values: rss, github-api-search, anthropic-news-html, huggingface-blog-html, google-cloud-blog-html.
fieldGuide.url: RSS/Atom URL or GitHub Search API URL.
fieldGuide.timeoutMs: Optional per-source timeout in milliseconds. Useful for large or slow feeds.
fieldGuide.limit: Max items fetched per run for this source.
fieldGuide.minStars: Optional GitHub filter. Drop repositories below this star count after parsing.
fieldGuide.minPopularityScore: Optional GitHub filter. Popularity score uses Stars*5 + Forks*3 + Watchers.
fieldGuide.tags: Used for filtering and report display.
fieldGuide.keywords: Optional. Only used by github-html parsers or future source filters.
fieldGuide.notes: Optional human notes for yourself. The current pipeline ignores this field.
